title: Plan
description: Validates the Codex Planner output artifact for the Supervisor-CAO platform. A plan enumerates the target files, ordered implementation steps, the test matrix, rollback conditions, and completion criteria. PUBLIC schema: sanitized, contains no secrets, hostnames, or private paths.

plan_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the plan.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this plan addresses.

target_files.description: List of file paths the plan intends to modify.

file.description: File path the step touches, when applicable.

risk_level.description: Assessed risk level of the step.

steps.description: Ordered implementation steps produced by the planner.

test_matrix.description: Test selectors or scenarios the executor must run to validate the change.

rollback_conditions.description: Conditions under which the executor should roll back the change.

completion_criteria.description: Criteria that must all be satisfied for the plan to be considered complete.

risks.description: Known risks the planner identified for this plan.

prerequisites_verified.description: Whether the planner verified all prerequisites before emitting the plan.

baseline_sha.description: Git SHA of the baseline commit the plan is built against.

model.description: Identifier of the model that produced the plan.
